headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4 headings, KPI numbers, and architectural labels.

body.usage: Use for dense dashboard data, tooltips, and map legends.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Overlines and small labels MUST be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] with font-semibold.
Max H1 size is text-5xl or text-6xl (clamp). Do not use text-7xl+.
Line height: leading-none for headings, leading-relaxed for body.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use teal green/blue (#1B93A4). Use the Emerald/Moss green (#059669) as the accent.
Use #0F172A (Deep Navy) as the primary driving color for structural elements and typography.
Backgrounds must be pristine white or slate-50. Avoid dark mode unless specifically toggled for the map view.
Do not use full-screen gradients. Keep it flat, clean, and architectural.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders ('The Technical Look'). Expose the skeleton. Dashboards should use border-collapse style layouts with 1px subtle borders (border-border/60). Avoid heavy card drop-shadows. Use flat, crisp edges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' ONLY for the floating AI Chatbot widget, sticky headers, or map overlay panels. Must have backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/80, and a 1px solid white/border-slate-200 edge.
visual_enhancers.patterns: Use SVG grid dot patterns (text-slate-200) for the landing page hero background and auth screens to simulate architectural blueprints.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for active states, or a sharp 4px offset shadow (neo-brutalist lite) for primary buttons to give physical depth.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col bento grid. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layouts.map_layout: Full bleed or large constrained container with floating UI panels overlapping the map.
layouts.spacing: Generous on landing/auth (p-12, py-24). Dense but structured on dashboards (p-4 to p-6 inside cards).
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Optical alignment over mathematical.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp slightly-rounded (rounded-md). Primary buttons use Deep Navy bg with white text. Accent buttons use Emerald Green. Include hover state with slight translate-y and increased shadow.
components.cards: Cardless or flat cards. 1px border-slate-200, bg-white, no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-md.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. border-slate-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-500.
components.map: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap tiles. Overlay with interactive SVG/GeoJSON polygons colored by zoning type. Clickable zones trigger a side-panel (glassmorphic) with area/capacity data.
components.ai_chatbot: Floating widget (bottom right). Glassmorphism surface. Chat bubbles should differentiate user (Navy) and AI (white/gray) with subtle green accents for AI.
components.header: Sticky top, solid bg-white or heavy glassmorphism. Never fully transparent if content scrolls beneath.
components.score_rings: Use Recharts or SVG circular progress indicators for Composite/Sustainability scores. Deep Navy track with Emerald progress.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion fade and slight slide-up (y: 10, opacity: 0 to 1).
motion.hover_states: Buttons and interactive map zones must scale up slightly (scale: 1.02) or change border/fill color instantly.
motion.data_loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the architectural grid rather than spinning wheels.
motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do not use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over map or colored zones has sufficient contrast. Use APCA standards.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="map-zone-residential"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium, high-performance urban planning dashboard (SmartScape).
The overall vibe is 'Architectural SaaS' - clean lines, plenty of whitespace, 1px borders, deep navy and emerald accents.

Use react-leaflet for the main Interactive Map. Overlay it with clickable SVG polygons representing zoning (residential, commercial, green space, etc.). The map needs to look professional (use a clean OSM tile style if possible).
Implement the multi-step New Planning Project workflow with a clear progress indicator.
Implement Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, forms, buttons, and tables, customizing them to fit the flat/grid technical style (remove heavy shadows, keep borders crisp).
Do NOT use HTML input type='date' or generic <select>; use Shadcn versions.
In the Dashboard, use Recharts for Sustainability radial charts and infrastructure metrics.
The Floating AI Chatbot should be a fixed widget with a glassmorphism container.
Provide a 'Demo Login' button on the Auth pages that auto-fills and submits.
Create realistic Indian urban-planning demo data for the map zones, proposals, and KPIs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (like overlays).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
